description: Source code for ActivityMonitor plugin, managing memory and CPU usage monitoring, threshold events, and process info collection within WPEFramework.

classes.name: MemoryInfo
classes.description: Provides static methods for system memory and CPU info, process info, and registry management.

classes.name: ActivityMonitor
classes.description: Main plugin class handling monitoring logic, threshold events, and process info collection.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Configuration for individual monitored applications, including thresholds and state.

classes.name: MonitorParams
classes.description: Holds monitoring parameters such as intervals, configs, and CPU usage totals.

methods.name: getApplicationMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage for a specific application by PID.

methods.name: getAllMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage for all monitored applications.

methods.name: enableMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring with specified configuration and intervals.

methods.name: disableMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring and cleans up resources.

methods.name: monitoring
methods.description: Main loop for periodic memory and CPU usage checks, threshold event handling.

methods.name: onMemoryThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Triggers notification when memory threshold is exceeded or receded.

methods.name: onCPUThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Triggers notification when CPU threshold is exceeded or receded.
